integrity: The proof is analytic. A standalone exact integer/rational finite-case checker is supplied; finite runs are corroboration, not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Only n>=4, strictly positive real edge weights and the intrinsic standard Euclidean incidence realization. Unit-weight special cases known. No assertion of best possible odd-cycle stability coefficient, and historical priority not independently established.
title: Parity rigidity of optimal Euclidean circumspheres in weighted cycle zonotopes
